subject: English
passage: Carved from single blocks of Italian marble and polished using a stone finishing technique learned from the sculptor's Florentine master, ______ so luminous and gracefully proportioned that viewers are compelled to walk around them to appreciate every angle.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: the Romanian sculptor Constantin Brâncuși creates neoclassical statues that are
choices.B: when he creates his neoclassical statues, Romanian sculptor Constantin Brâncuși makes them
choices.C: Constantin Brâncuși is a Romanian sculptor whose neoclassical statues are
choices.D: the neoclassical statues of Romanian sculptor Constantin Brâncuși are

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-modifier placement. This choice makes the noun phrase "neoclassical statues" the subject of the sentence and places it immediately after the modifying phrase "carved…master." In doing so, this choice clearly establishes that the neoclassical statues—and not another noun in the sentence—are being described as carved from marble and polished.
